articles.title: Hex founder Richard Heart arrested in Istanbul, Turkish media report
articles.snippet: Police reportedly seized $4 million in cash and 64 luxury watches during a raid on the crypto founder's Istanbul residence.

articles.title: Three Canadian Armed Forces Members Charged in Kidnapping of Crypto Exchange Owner
articles.snippet: Police seized guns, silencers and more than 2,000 rounds of ammunition, nearly all of it allegedly stolen from the Canadian military.

articles.title: Hex Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul on Interpol Red Notice: Report
articles.snippet: Turkish police and intelligence officers reportedly seized cash, phones, jewelry and firearms at the crypto founder's address in Beşiktaş.
